purpose: Governed exclusions from a target-resolved dependency closure. An exclusion is a REVIEWED, APPROVED, DATED decision about one exact resolved package in one exact target — never a pattern, never a silent suppression.
semantic: A valid exclusion REMOVES the exact governed node and every edge incident to it from the reconciled closure, and records it in a separate `excluded` set carried by the reconciliation report. Reconciliation then runs against the reduced closure, so an applied exclusion is observable as a smaller graph plus an explicit governed record. It never leaves a component quietly matching as though nothing happened.

field_contract.scope: One of that target's declared dependency_scopes.
field_contract.resolution_key: Exact lockfile resolution key including any peer context. No wildcards, no name-only values.
field_contract.parent_edge: An edge that genuinely exists in that target's closure, in '<from> -> <to>' form.
field_contract.reason: Why this exact resolution is excluded, in terms a reviewer can check.
field_contract.evidence: Repo-relative path to the evidence supporting the decision.
field_contract.evidence_sha256: SHA-256 hex digest of that evidence file, so the approval is bound to exact bytes.
field_contract.owner: The party responsible for the excluded dependency.
field_contract.approver: The party who approved the exclusion. MUST differ from owner — an exclusion cannot approve itself.
field_contract.approved_on: ISO YYYY-MM-DD date the approval was granted.
field_contract.expires_on: ISO YYYY-MM-DD date after which the exclusion is rejected and must be re-reviewed.

rejection_rules.wildcard_or_name_only: resolution_key containing '*' or '?', or lacking an exact version, is rejected.
rejection_rules.stale_not_in_closure: resolution_key not resolved anywhere in pnpm-lock.yaml is rejected: the reviewed subject no longer exists.
rejection_rules.unused_never_applied: resolution_key resolved by the lockfile but absent from the declared target's closure is rejected: the entry excluded nothing.
rejection_rules.version_changed: The package name is in the closure at a different version than the one reviewed; the approval does not carry over.
rejection_rules.wrong_target: Unknown target, or a scope that is not one of that target's declared dependency_scopes.
rejection_rules.wrong_parent: parent_edge is not an actual edge of that target's closure.
rejection_rules.expired: expires_on is before the run date.
rejection_rules.unapproved: Missing or malformed evidence_sha256, a non-ISO approval/expiry date, or approver identical to owner.
rejection_rules.excludes_compatible_mandatory_dependency: A target-compatible MANDATORY (non-optional) dependency can never be excluded — the closure would misrepresent what is actually installed.

enforcement: scripts/gate/lib/reconcile.mjs governExclusions() + applyExclusions(). Every rule above is driven by a control in apps/api/test/gate/c16-closure-controls.test.ts, including a positive fixture proving a valid exclusion is applied exactly once.
